title: Landfall
style: cinematic 35mm film still, warm late-September Aegean light, honey-coloured limestone, deep blue sea, natural colour, no text, no logos
ambience: gentle Mediterranean harbour at morning: small waves lapping a stone quay, distant gulls, soft wind, faint rigging chimes

shots.line: Welcome to Rhodes. Stand still at the bottom of the gangway and look west, at the wall.
shots.still: view from the foot of a cruise ship gangway on a stone quay at dawn, looking across the harbour at the massive medieval walls and towers of Rhodes old town
shots.motion: slow push-in toward the walls, morning haze lifting, water glinting

shots.line: For three thousand years people have arrived on this shore from the water, looking at the town.
shots.still: low over the water approaching the fortified harbour of Rhodes, crenellated walls, windmills on the mole, domes and a minaret behind the ramparts
shots.motion: gliding forward over gentle swell toward the harbour mouth

shots.still: a classical ancient Greek war galley (trireme), long low black hull with three banks of oars, a painted eye on the bow, a bronze ram at the waterline, one square sail furled, rowing across a sunlit bay; historically accurate, 4th century BC
shots.motion: oars sweep in unison, spray off the ram

shots.still: a Roman merchant galley with a square red sail entering a harbour lined with white marble colonnades
shots.motion: sail fills with wind, galley glides past the camera

shots.still: candlelit interior of a small Byzantine chapel, gold mosaic and faded frescoes of saints on plaster walls
shots.motion: candle flames flicker, slow drift across the fresco

shots.still: armoured knights of St John in black surcoats with a white cross, on horseback under a stone gatehouse, red banner with a white cross
shots.motion: banners stir, horses shift and stamp

shots.still: an Ottoman fleet of galleys with crimson crescent banners anchored in a wide blue bay beneath a walled city
shots.motion: banners ripple, galleys rock on the swell

shots.still: a 1930s steamship moored at a stone quay beside a pale rationalist colonnaded building, figures in linen suits and hats
shots.motion: smoke curls from the funnel, people stroll along the quay

shots.still: modern travellers seen from behind, walking down a cruise ship gangway onto a sunny stone quay toward medieval walls, a huge white ship beside them
shots.motion: travellers walk away from camera toward the walls

shots.still: ancient harbour market at the quayside, stacked clay amphorae, bales of cloth, merchants haggling beside moored wooden ships
shots.motion: merchants gesture and carry amphorae, gulls cross the frame

shots.still: night siege of a walled ancient Greek harbour city in 305 BC: wooden oared war galleys with square sails in the bay, a huge wooden siege tower on a ship, fire arrows arcing, burning braziers on stone ramparts, orange glow on the water; historically accurate, nothing modern
shots.motion: arrows streak across the sky, flames surge, smoke rolls

shots.line: The city was built around a single certainty: that someone was always coming.
shots.still: a lone sentry in a simple medieval tunic on a stone rampart at dusk, looking out over the empty sea toward the horizon
shots.motion: wind moves the sentry's cloak, slow push past his shoulder toward the horizon

shots.line: The moat, the bastions, the gates: an answer to that.
shots.still: a deep dry moat below the medieval walls of Rhodes, grass and wild fig trees, stone cannonballs piled in the grass, a massive round bastion and a gate with a stone bridge
shots.motion: slow crane along the moat toward the gate and bridge

shots.line: Walk toward the wall, and keep the sea on your left.
shots.still: point of view walking along a sunny harbour promenade, calm blue sea on the left, the golden medieval walls and a gate tower ahead on the right
shots.motion: steady forward walk toward the gate, sea sparkling on the left
